title: Quantum Circuit Representation of Combinatorial Matrix Functions
summary: Permanents, hafnians, and loop-hafnians are combinatorial matrix functions closely related to perfect matchings in graphs. These matrix functions arise in the quantum amplitudes of boson configurations in bosonic networks, and the classical hardness of computing them has been used to establish hardness arguments for boson sampling and Gaussian boson sampling. Remarkably, these matrix functions also appear in quantum spin systems.
